[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.grobid` |
| Source | `09_docker/grobid.yaml` |

GROBID PDF parsing service used to extract structured metadata, references, and
full-text from scholarly PDFs in the document ingestion pipeline.
